value.rationale: Original closed_permanent classification appears based solely on official domain redirect. Multiple recent (2025-2026) third-party booking platforms and hotel/tourism sources still treat the course as operational. Recommend downgrading to operational/medium until on-the-ground verification (phone +66 84 704 3344 Golfasian / direct site visit) confirms. Domain loss alone is insufficient evidence for permanent closure, especially since the parent (PT Hotel Indonesia Natour / InJourney Hospitality) still operates the adjacent The Meru Sanur & Bali Beach Hotel and references the golf course in marketing.
